ov: FlexRadio 8400MATU HF/6-Meter Signature Series SDR Transceivers FlexRadio 8400MATU HF/6-Meter Signature Series SDR Transceivers feature an integrated antenna tuner (ATU), and the latest direct sampling SDR technology, paired with a high-resolution display and ergonomic controls. The FLEX-8400M combines all the capabilities of the FLEX-8400 with a stunning 8-inch 1920×1200 IPS WUXGA touchscreen and intuitive controls, delivering high-performance SDR functionality in a traditional radio interface. Unmatched band awareness comes from the integrated display, while support for external monitors at 1900×1200 resolution enhances spectral visibility. The integrated automatic antenna tuner (ATU) is designed to match antennas with up to 3:1 SWR on 80–10 meters and up to 2.5:1 SWR on 160 and 6 meters.Designed with input from top contest and DX operators, the symmetrical and independent dual VFO controls are strategically placed to maximize productivity across all operating styles. Fully self-contained, the transceiver requires no PC, network, or steep learning curve—just plug in and operate.When connected to a PC, laptop, or Mac client, users can access up to two 7 MHz spectrum/waterfall displays and independent receivers, transforming how bands are viewed. Both receivers can operate simultaneously on any band and mode, with instant QSY between VFOs. Digital mode operation is streamlined—no sound cards, cables, or external boxes needed.FlexRadio’s industry-leading SmartSDR™ software ensures compatibility across the entire FLEX-8000 Signature Series, enabling continuous software enhancements. For expanded spectral visibility, it also supports external monitors at 1900×1200 resolution via HDMI—ideal for detailed spectrum and waterfall analysis.Dual Independent Receivers with Full Band Flexibility: Operate with confidence using two fully independent receivers, each capable of tuning any band and mode simultaneously. Product Condition: Open Box Band Agility: All-band SSB/CW Minimum Power: 1 W AM Minimum Power: 1 W FlexRadio Aurora 500W HF+6M SDR Transceivers FlexRadio AURORA™ SERIES is an all-new family of HF + 6M transceivers featuring the world's first truly integrated 500 watt SDR transmitter. The Aurora Series defines a new category in amateur radio, eliminating the traditional boundaries between transceiver, amplifier, tuner, and power supply. Designed for the modern operator, the Aurora Series delivers exceptional RF performance in a radically compact form factor—leveraging cutting-edge high-efficiency technology that produces more power with less weight, lower heat, and dramatically reduced power input requirements. Aurora Series transceivers are network ready, designed for remote access with SmartSDR clients on any Windows, macOS, iPad®, iPhone®, or Maestro™ device, in your shack, easy chair, or from virtually anywhere in the world!
